title: BlackCat's Villager Update
description: A mod made to add more (cursed) interactions with the villagers
body:
# BlackCat's Village Update


### Overview
I bet you find the villagers a bit dull. This mod makes them more useful! This mod adds more ways to troll, oops sorry, interact with villagers.
 
**_Features_**
- Main Feature: Holdable villagers
- Tools: Tools made out of villager. Their efficiency are comparable to netherite because of their super hard heads.
- Blocks: Stacked villagers block.

**_Usage_**
> Right click a villager to take him as an item.

 **_Compatibility_**
> This mod is compatible to almost every villager mods that adds professions and structures.

This mod is still in developpement so contact us if there is any glitches.

Know bugs :
- ~~We can't trade with the villagers~~ Fixed
- The golem has no animations


If you want to use it in a modpack or in a video, you can, just send me a message to let me know.
